The batch is now with you.

reply.thought: I need to verify that the refunds reported by Alpha Co match the refunds recorded in my system before recording any payouts. I will call list_refunds to retrieve the recorded refunds.
The refunds reported by Alpha Co (orders 192 and 193) match the recorded refunds. I will now retrieve each customer's net balance using net_balance.

The net_balance call failed because customer CUST192 does not exist. I need to find the correct customer identifier for order 192. I will call list_orders to see the order details and find the customer ID.
I have the order details. Order 192 belongs to customer 'cobalt'. I will now get the net balance for customer 'cobalt'.
I have the net balance for cobalt (18779 cents). Now I need the net balance for acme (order 193).
I have net balances for cobalt (18779 cents) and acme (33841 cents). Next, I need the net balance for birch (order 194).
I now have net balances for cobalt (18779), acme (33841), and birch (40664). I will record the payouts for each customer.

result.error: bad arguments: World.record_payout() got an unexpected keyword argument 'amount_cent'. Did you mean 'amount_cents'?

reply.thought: The record_payout call failed due to a typo in the argument name. I need to use 'amount_cents' instead of 'amount_cent'.
The payout for cobalt has been recorded successfully. Now I will record the payout for acme.
The payout for acme has been recorded successfully. Now I will record the payout for birch.
The previous record_ payout call failed because of a typo in the tool name (extra space). I need to call record_ payout correctly.
The tool name still has a space typo. I need to call record_ payout without the space, i.e., record_payout.
All payouts have been recorded successfully. Now I will finish the batch with a report of the payouts.

The 'done' tool is not recognized. I need to use the correct tool name to finalize the batch. I will use 'record_payout' to confirm the final status, but since all payouts are already recorded, I need to check if there is a different tool. The specification says to finish with  {"done": true, ...}. Since that tool is unknown, I will assume the task is complete after recording payouts, and I will output the final report directly as the response, adhering to the JSON format required.
